title: Practical gates by Majorana fermion motion
summary: Quantum error correction protocols protect against local errors by storing logical information non-locally. This poses a challenge: how to design efficient logical gates on the non-local ``hidden'' logical information, and how to implement these gates using the local physical operations. We develop a general description of planar Pauli stabilizer codes and protocols for logical operations in terms of point-like particles called Majorana fermions.
